Animal Rescue Kochi is a registered non-profit animal welfare organization based in Kochi, Kerala, dedicated to rescuing, treating, rehabilitating, and rehoming injured, abandoned, and neglected animals.

Through our rescue centre,we provide emergency medical care, shelter, sterilization, vaccinations, and lifelong care for animals in need. In collaboration with Mission Rabies India, we also work to create safer communities through free anti-rabies vaccination programs, rabies response, and public awareness initiatives.
On this channel, you’ll find:
• Animal rescue stories
• Medical treatments and rehabilitation
• Happy adoption journeys
• Community animal welfare initiatives
• Rabies awareness and prevention
• Sterilisation & Responsible ownership

Every rescue is made possible by the kindness and support of people like you. Subscribe to follow our journey, share our mission, and help us give vulnerable animals a second chance at life.Together, we can build a kinder world for animals.
